newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine ship catches fire on gas leak, 3 hurt.
newsitem.headline: Philippine ship catches fire on gas leak, 3 hurt.

text.p: A ship with a leaking cargo of petroleum products burst into flames in Zamboanga City port on Saturday, injuring three people, crew members and officials said.

A fourth crewman was missing, and the fire partially burned another vessel used for marine research by the Zamboanga State College of Marine Science and Technology, Zamboanga Bureau of Fire Protection director Felipe Carpio told reporters.
The three injured men received second-degree burns, Carpio said. The other members of the 10-man crew of the 150-ft (46-m) M/L Petron were not hurt.
The vessel was about to leave Zamboanga port for nearby Tawi-tawi island when it caught fire, its chief mechanic, Danny Villangan, told reporters.
Its cargo included 50,000 litres (11,000 gallons) of gasoline, 30,000 litres of kerosene, 20,000 litres of gas and 300 cylinders of liquified petroleum gas.
